prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Welcome Your New Desktop Companion!", "Your pet adoption certificate is official. Prepare your desktop workspace for their arrival."]
1: ["Checking graphics acceleration and desktop window permissions...", "Testing Desktop Display Permissions", "We are making sure your pet can freely wander across your screens.", "Verifying screen overlay capability..."]
2: ["Save Your Companion to Your Cloud Account", "Sign in now to lock in your pet selection across all your devices."]
3: ["Try Out Your Desktop Controls", "Use quick shortcuts to summon, move, or minimize your pet at any time while working.", "Practice Desktop Shortcuts", "Got It! Start Desktop Pet"]
4: ["Sync & Secure Your Desktop Pets", "Signing in ensures your pet settings, items, and custom models are permanently saved to your account across reinstalls.", "Already have a pet on this account? It will be automatically restored."]
5: ["Preparing Your Pet's New Workspace...", "Did you know? Double clicking your pet opens quick pet interactions."]
6: ["Select Your Adoption Journey", "Pick how you would like to create or select your companion today."]
7: ["Use bright, evenly lit photos with your pet centered for the best 3D desktop model generation."]
8: ["Welcome to Your New Desktop Experience!", "You've unlocked the Pioneer Adoption Badge for completing setup.", "Desktop Companion Pioneer"]
9: ["Connecting to sign-in servers... Click retry if screen does not load."]

verdicts.problem: Creates urgency by telling the user to sign in now to lock in their selection.
